description: This file defines and exports constants and modules used for graph layout algorithms and visualization within a larger project. It includes functions for graph management, layout calculations, and various algorithms for positioning nodes, including radial and tree layouts.

classes.name: h
classes.description: Class implementing a layout or processing object with methods for performing graph layout calculations, including radial layout, tree processing, and force-directed algorithms.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the layout process, initializing layout steps, managing animation, and invoking layout algorithms.

methods.name: getTopMostNodes
methods.description: Identifies topmost nodes in a node list for hierarchical layout purposes.

methods.name: processChildrenList
methods.description: Recursively processes and adds child nodes to layout groups, preparing for layout calculations.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Interrupts stopping the layout process.

methods.name: radialLayout
methods.description: Calculates the position of a node in a radial layout based on tree depth and separation constants.

methods.name: branchRadialLayout
methods.description: Recursively arranges nodes around a branch to create a radial distribution based on angles and radius.

methods.name: calculateNodesToApplyGravitationTo
methods.description: Selects nodes where gravitation forces should be applied during layout.

methods.name: createDummyNodesForBendpoints
methods.description: Creates placeholder dummy nodes for layout bendpoints to facilitate edge routing.

methods.name: positionNodesRadially
methods.description: Positions nodes in a radial pattern based on their hierarchical structure.

methods.name: repopulateCompounds
methods.description: Repositions compound nodes after layout adjustments.

methods.name: radialLayout
methods.description: Calculates the position of a node in a radial layout based on tree depth and separation constants.

methods.name: calculateArrowAngles
methods.description: Calculates the angles for arrows on edges based on their control points and edge types, storing the results in edge scratch data.

methods.name: getArrowWidth
methods.description: Computes the width of arrows given the arrow scale and width parameters, with caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getArrowHeight
methods.description: Computes the height of arrows given the arrow scale and width parameters, with caching for efficiency.

methods.name: findMidptPtsEtc
methods.description: Finds midpoint points, vectors, and related data for edges based on edge type, used for drawing curved edges.

methods.name: findHaystackPoints
methods.description: Determines points for 'haystack' style edges, placing source and target points based on node positions and radii.

methods.name: findSegmentsPoints
methods.description: Calculates intermediate segment points for edges styled as segments, based on segment weights and distances.

methods.name: findLoopPoints
methods.description: Calculates control points for self-loop edges with loop style, based on direction and sweep parameters.

methods.name: findCompoundLoopPoints
methods.description: Calculates control points for compound node loops (self-edges with nested nodes), based on source and target positions.

methods.name: findStraightEdgePoints
methods.description: Sets edge scratch data for straight-line edges.

methods.name: findBezierPoints
methods.description: Calculates control points for Bezier or multibezier edges, including intersection calculations and control point correction.

methods.name: findTaxiPoints
methods.description: Calculates control points for 'taxi' style edges, handling various edge routing styles.

methods.name: storeAllpts
methods.description: Stores all computed points (control points, segments, etc.) in edge scratch data for later use.

methods.name: checkForInvalidEdgeWarning
methods.description: Checks edge endpoints for validity and logs warnings if endpoints are invalid.

methods.name: findEdgeControlPoints
methods.description: Determines control points based on edge style, calling specific functions for Bezier curves, segments, etc.

methods.name: recalculateNodeLabelProjection
methods.description: Recalculates the position for node labels based on node position and style.

methods.name: calculateLabelDimensions
methods.description: Calculates text label dimensions (width and height) using canvas measurement, with caching.

methods.name: calculateLabelAngles
methods.description: Calculates label angles for edges, source labels, and target labels based on their positions.

methods.name: calculateLabelAngle
methods.description: Determines the rotation angle for text labels based on position and style.

methods.name: applyLabelDimensions
methods.description: Applies computed label dimensions to the element's style and scratch data.

methods.name: getLabelText
methods.description: Retrieves the text for a label with optional transformations and text wrapping.

methods.name: getLabelJustification
methods.description: Determines the justification (alignment) of labels based on style settings.

methods.name: getNodeShape
methods.description: Identifies the shape of a node, with fallback for small sizes and support for polygon shapes.

methods.name: updateCachedZSortedEles
methods.description: Updates the cached array of elements sorted by z-order, considering interaction states and layering.

methods.name: invalidateCachedZSortedEles
methods.description: Invalidates the cached z-sorted element list, forcing recalculation.

methods.name: getCachedZSortedEles
methods.description: Retrieves the cached or recalculated array of elements sorted by z-order, optionally updating cache.

methods.name: registerCalculationListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for recalculating element styles, layout, and rendering updates.

methods.name: recalculateRenderedStyle
methods.description: Recalculates the rendering style of elements, including node label positions and edge projections.

methods.name: getArrowHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of arrows given the arrow scale and width parameters, with caching for efficiency.
